description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.
